query: Uber Ola Mumbai fare rate per km base fare 2026
snippet: MMRTA directed Ola/Uber/Rapido to adopt kaali-peeli taxi fare structure. Regulated per-km: ~Rs 28/km hatchback, Rs 31/km sedan, Rs 34/km SUV. Base fare from ~Rs 31. Surge capped at 1.5x during peak hours, discounts up to 25% off-peak. This replaces the old ~Rs 15/km app-only fares -- a real, dated regulatory change, not a generic estimate.

query: Mumbai Ola Uber minimum fare night charge airport surcharge rupees
snippet: Ola Mini: base fare Rs 50, minimum fare Rs 60, per-minute Rs 1.25. Uber: base fare Rs 99.75-157.50 depending on tier, per-km Rs 7.35-17.85, per-minute Rs 1.05-2.01 (these are pre-regulation self-reported app rates, likely superseded by the MMRTA directive above for the per-km rate specifically). Night surcharge +25% (1.25x). Airport pickup surcharge Rs 50-130 depending on source.
